Analysts See $-0.01 EPS for Polar Power, Inc. (POLA); Denver Investment Advisors Has Lifted By $1.08 Million Its Sinclair Broadcast Group (SBGI) Stake 
April 18, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Denver Investment Advisors Llc increased Sinclair Broadcast Group (SBGI) stake by 3.77% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Denver Investment Advisors Llc acquired 29,259 shares as Sinclair Broadcast Group (SBGI)’s stock declined 16.75%. The Denver Investment Advisors Llc holds 805,833 shares with $30.50M value, up from 776,574 last quarter. Sinclair Broadcast Group now has $2.99B valuation. (NASDAQ:SBGI) has declined 20.99% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 32.54% the S&P500. 
Analysts expect Polar Power, Inc. (NASDAQ:POLA) to report $-0.01 EPS on April, 27.They anticipate $0.07 EPS change or 116.67% from last quarter’s $0.06 EPS. After having $-0.06 EPS previously, Polar Power, Inc.’s analysts see -83.33% EPS growth. The stock increased 3.65% or $0.22 during the last trading session, reaching $6.24. About 31,064 shares traded or 48.23% up from the average. Polar Power, Inc. (NASDAQ:POLA) has declined 37.59% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 49.14% the S&P500. 
Polar Power, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells direct current power systems for applications in the telecommunications, military, electric vehicle charging, cogeneration, distributed power, and uninterruptable power supply markets. The company has market cap of $63.29 million. It offers DC base power systems, DC hybrid power systems, and DC solar hybrid power systems. It currently has negative earnings. Polar Power, Inc. installs, sells, and services its products through its direct sales force, and a network of independent service providers and dealers.
